idea_name: DoEasy abstract indicator buffer object (library scaffolding)
mechanism: Defines CBuffer as an OOP wrapper around PlotIndexSet*/SetIndexBuffer with ENUM_BUFFER_STATUS drawing styles, integer/double/string property arrays, and colored DRAW_* mapping via Status+8. Test creates arrow and line buffers on a chart and verifies ArraySize equals rates_total. No market-state measurement is built—only indicator buffer plumbing.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; used TFs M5,M15,M30,H1 in test; chart period M30 at launch
why_new_for_mis: No new MIS sensing idea after full read; MQL5 library OOP for indicator buffers.
quote: we obtain the ability to simply "tell" our program "create the buffer of this type", and the library will create the buffer and any subsequent buffers without the need to independently declare arrays

idea_name: Skipped-bars gap event from NewBar inter-arrival
mechanism: On each NewBar, CNewBarObj stores previous new-bar time and computes m_seconds_between = tm - prev and m_bars_between = seconds/PeriodSeconds(tf). If BarsBetweenNewBars()>1, emit SERIES_EVENTS_MISSING_BARS via EventChartCustom with lparam=missing count, dparam=timeframe, sparam=symbol—flagging history holes after disconnect/sleep rather than treating every NewBar as contiguous.
data_needed: Per-symbol/timeframe bar open times; PeriodSeconds; connection/resume path that still fires NewBar
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Library-general; test uses GBPUSD M5 AC on EURUSD M1 chart; used-period list includes current chart TF
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an explicit feed-integrity / discontinuity change event (gap size in bars) usable to invalidate sensors or force timeseries rebuild after outages.
quote: In case of connection loss, enabling/disabling sleep mode and other abnormal events that require time to recover, we can see that some history bars are skipped in the library database after the program resumes its operation.

idea_name: Cross-symbol cross-TF standard-indicator remap onto current chart
mechanism: CreateAC(symbol,timeframe) attaches iAC handle plus drawn histogram and calculated buffers tagged by BUFFER_PROP_ID/IND_HANDLE/IND_TYPE. SetDataBufferStdInd maps via iBarShift on the calc TF, then paints num_bars=PeriodSeconds(calc_TF)/PeriodSeconds(PERIOD_CURRENT) current-chart bars with that higher-TF AC value and color by value0 vs prior. Sensor state of AC on any symbol/TF is projected onto the viewing chart’s bar grid.
data_needed: iAC(handle) data; iBarShift/iTime alignment; dual BUFFER_TYPE_DATA + BUFFER_TYPE_CALCULATE objects
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Test: GBPUSD PERIOD_M30 input, displayed on EURUSD M1; GIF compares GBPUSD M5 AC
why_new_for_mis: Frames multi-asset/multi-horizon oscillator state as a first-class remapped sensing layer MIS can attach without rewriting per-TF indicators.
quote: the ability to create custom indicators displaying data on all standard indicators, calculated for the specified symbols/periods, on the current symbol/period chart.

idea_name: Abstract CIndicatorDE object with trend/oscillator/volumes/arrows groups
mechanism: Builds CIndicatorDE wrapping IndicatorCreate/IndicatorRelease with status (standard/custom), group enums, MqlParam equality, and Select helpers. Test instantiates AC oscillator object, prints properties, deletes it. Taxonomy is for library sorting, not a live market regime classifier.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4/H1 in test journal; AC on H4
why_new_for_mis: No new MIS sensing idea after full read; indicator object scaffolding and group labels.
quote: Thus, we will be able to sort indicators by groups in programs. We will not enter Bill Williams’ indicators in a separate group because each of them has its affiliation with one of the specified groups.

why_new_for_mis: No new MIS sensing idea after full read; factory/collection for standard indicators.

series_key: trading with the mql5 economic calendar
mechanism: News_FormatRemain decomposes (eventTime−now) into d/h/m/s strings ("in 14m 22s", "Released", "now"). News_RemainIsImminent returns true when 0<diffSec≤30*60 so the Remain cell paints g_news_remainSoon. Timer fast-path News_TickRemainCells repaints only cells whose string changed every 500ms.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multi-currency calendar events; live windows via start_time/end_time PERIOD_H12 defaults; tester StartDate–EndDate
why_new_for_mis: Provides a continuous pre-event proximity change sensor MIS can threshold for news-risk windows without polling full dashboard redraws.
quote: It returns true only when the event is in the future and within 30 minutes — a window we treat as urgent enough to highlight the Remain cell in red

series_key: trading with the mql5 economic calendar
idea_name: Actual-vs-forecast surprise direction and revised-previous marker
mechanism: Loader stores hasActual/hasForecast/hasPrevious/hasRevised flags separately from doubles so 0.0≠missing. Render colors actual green (g_news_actualUp) when it beats forecast and red (g_news_actualDown) when it misses; gold revisedMark triangle with hover tooltip for revised previous. Unit-aware News_FormatValue attaches K/M/B/%/jobs metadata.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: MT5 economic calendar across currencies; impact none/low/med/high pills
why_new_for_mis: Turns calendar prints into a signed surprise and revision sensor MIS can fuse with price reaction around release time.
quote: without these flags, a published value of 0.0 was indistinguishable from a missing value, so the dashboard could not tell whether to show a number or a dash.

series_key: trading with the mql5 economic calendar
idea_name: Currency×impact×time news-event filter stack as macro attention regime
mechanism: Master toggles plus per-currency chips and impact pills (none/low/med/high) plus time-range filter produce g_news_displayableEvents; row plan inserts collapsible day separators. Only events surviving the stack are trade candidates under NEWS_TRADE_BEFORE/AFTER with offset H/M/S—defining which macro-news regime the EA currently attends to.
data_needed: Calendar events with currency and importance; filter boolean arrays; range_time window
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Currencies present in calendar; tradeLotSize/offsets; live H12 lookback/lookahead defaults
why_new_for_mis: Operationalizes macro-news attention as an explicit multi-axis regime mask MIS can share across strategies.
quote: The logic module owns all data operations — loading events, applying filters, building the row plan, and managing trade candidate searches.

series_key: trading with the mql5 economic calendar
idea_name: Shared SQLite calendar upsert keyed by value_id for live/tester parity
mechanism: News_DbOpen uses DATABASE_OPEN_COMMON so live and tester share NewsCalendarEA.db. events table PRIMARY KEY value_id with INSERT OR REPLACE upserts actual/forecast/previous/revised plus unit metadata; idx_events_time supports window loads. Live mode upserts every API refresh in a transaction; tester only SELECTs the backtest window—same sensing store, no recompile.
data_needed: CalendarValueHistory + Event/Country/Value by id; Common/Files path; transaction begin/commit
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Calendar-wide; download range inputs e.g. 2026.01.01–2026.05.12; prune keepDays=7
why_new_for_mis: Makes macro-event surprise state a durable cross-session sensing substrate MIS can query offline and online from one file.
quote: The common folder placement means the live chart agent and every strategy tester agent point at the same physical file.

series_key: trading with the mql5 economic calendar
mechanism: triggered table stores event_id PK + triggered_at; News_DbMarkTriggered uses INSERT OR IGNORE; on init News_DbLoadTriggered restores IDs where triggered_at >= now−86400 into g_news_triggeredIds for O(n) News_DbAlreadyTriggered checks. Prevents duplicate news orders across restarts/reboots within a rolling day.
data_needed: event_id on trade fire; SQLite triggered table; in-memory ID array
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same news EA; 24h restore window; 7-day event prune
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a restart-safe event-memory sensor so news-driven actions remain idempotent across process death.
quote: The triggered trade list is restored from the last twenty-four hours on every program restart.

idea_name: Period-scoped position feature store from entry/exit deals
mechanism: HistorySelect(start,finish) walks deals; filters BUY/SELL types; splits DEAL_ENTRY_IN (open,time,symbol,SL,TP,magic,volume,commission) vs DEAL_ENTRY_OUT (close,time,reason,swap,profit,fee); template Find() merges by DEAL_POSITION_ID into parallel arrays—one row per position for multi-TF screenshot analysis. Motivation text ties this to detecting whether strategy still fits flat vs trend market stages.
data_needed: Account deal history; position IDs; user start_date/finish_date or ticket
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any traded symbols in history; screenshot TFs main_graph PERIOD_D1 + addition H1 (+ optional #2/#3); example dates 17–19.07.2023
why_new_for_mis: Builds a deal-level outcome feature pack MIS can use as lagged feedback on whether recent trade distribution still matches the intended market phase.
quote: we can simplify this thesis by saying that the market can be in at least two stages - a flat movement and a trend. Therefore, it is very important to constantly analyze your trading activities to determine whether the chosen strategy is adequate to the market situation.
